messages.content: I need to be in suburban Phoenix for an opening review Tuesday and Wednesday. The Tuesday walkthrough starts at 9:00 a.m., so look at Monday evening flights from Chicago. I should finish Wednesday at 4:00, but there is a chance the meeting runs late.
What dates are you traveling, and which suburb is the restaurant in? That will determine whether a Wednesday flight is realistic after the meeting.
Monday, January 12 through Wednesday, January 14. The site is in Chandler, near Loop 202 and Arizona Avenue.

I found three useful nonstop outbound options. From ORD, American 1942 departs at 5:25 p.m. and arrives PHX at 8:19 p.m. for $387 round trip when paired with the Wednesday returns. United 2248 leaves at 6:35 p.m. and arrives at 9:31 p.m. for $412. Southwest from MDW leaves at 7:10 p.m. and arrives at 10:05 p.m. for $369. Are you leaving from the office downtown or from home Monday?
From the office. The 5:25 is probably too tight. Keep the United option unless the Midway flight gives me a meaningful advantage.

United is the better fit. Allowing for an afternoon trip from downtown, ORD is less sensitive to a late departure from the office than crossing to Midway during rush hour, and it gets you into Phoenix 34 minutes earlier. With a rental car, you should reach a Chandler hotel around 10:45 to 11:15 p.m. after landing. That still leaves a dependable morning for the 9:00 walkthrough.
Good. Now compare Wednesday returns. Show me one that works if we finish at 4:00 and another if I have to stay until about 5:30.

For a 4:00 p.m. finish, United 2036 departs PHX at 7:15 p.m. and arrives ORD at 11:25 p.m. It is included in the $412 round-trip fare. From the Chandler site, budget 40 to 55 minutes to PHX in late-afternoon traffic, then 15 to 25 minutes for fuel and rental-car return. Leaving by 4:10 should put you at the terminal around 5:20 to 5:40, giving you a reasonable margin.
And the later one? I don't want a plan that depends on the local team ending exactly at 5:30.

American 2871 departs at 9:05 p.m. and arrives ORD at 1:12 a.m. Thursday. Pairing that return with the United outbound requires separate one-way tickets totaling $458. If you leave the site at 5:45, a conservative estimate puts you at the terminal between 7:00 and 7:25 after traffic and the rental return. That leaves roughly 1 hour 40 minutes before departure. A third option at 8:10 p.m. is possible on paper, but it would be too exposed to a meeting overrun or heavy traffic.
Is there any reason to take the 9:05 now instead of waiting for the local team to confirm?

The main reason would be fare or seat availability, but operationally there is no need to commit yet. The 7:15 return is workable only if the meeting ends around 4:00; the 9:05 protects a meeting lasting until 5:30. The tradeoff is $46 more and getting home after 2:00 a.m. once you account for deplaning and the ride from ORD.
Hold both return candidates for the hotel and schedule decision. Which outbound should I carry forward exactly?

Carry forward United 2248 on Monday, January 12: ORD 6:35 p.m. to PHX 9:31 p.m. For Wednesday, keep United 2036 at 7:15 p.m. if the Chandler meeting has a firm 4:00 p.m. end, and American 2871 at 9:05 p.m. if it may run to 5:30. No flight has been booked. The next decision is whether the hotel location and Wednesday schedule support the earlier return.
